title: How to Add Videos to Multi-Photo Post Types
text:
## How to Add Videos to Multi-Photo Post Types
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000077558
It is now possible to add videos to multi-photo albums like classifieds, products, etc. Follow these steps to learn how!
Navigate to Content » Edit Post Settings and look for the multi-photo post type to enable this feature and click on " Edit ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094089241/original/pmJ_RT4QAncT-co2yjQDhxsoUpXsGqnHvA.png?1623757752 | alt: ]
On the General Settings tab, scroll down and click on "Additional Settings". Look for the Enable Photo Gallery Videos option and select "Yes":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12088586218/original/h0FQIGfzcN-FatE6htP0-g-RL5hkP-SlfQ.png?1612882662 | alt: ]
Once the feature has been enabled, members will be able to add videos to the uploaded pictures by entering a Youtube or Vimeo link:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183455673/original/W-OcQyHvk_qVJWWoBbmcwLAuICAV70K3Ow.png?1786460850 | alt: ]
*Do not forget to save the changes.
Here's an example of the final result:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183455681/original/LqPaYADkuCTGKzQtJ8k3uPGL4s50WBVCzQ.png?1786460862 | alt: ]
